title: Marguerite and the Confession
author: Ulyana Coldharbour
blurb: Orsen Coldharbour, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
